Coram : ABHAY MANOHAR SAPRE*, DINESH MAHESHWARI
Wildlife Life (Protection) Act, 1972 – ss. 18, 19, 20, 21, 22, 23, 24, 27 and 28 – Recovery of damages – Appellant-partnership firm had taken land on lease from its owner, the Mutt for purpose crops – The registered lease was for a period of 5 years i.e. 01.07.1972 to 30.06.1977 – The State issued notification dated 06.03.1976 for the purpose of wild life sanctuary which included the land in question – Thereafter, a fresh long-term lease for a period of 25 years
Decision Date : 20-08-2019 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 5397/2010 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
